preliminary_runs.d8d3fdbf2d: Greenfield/repeat/forms succeeded; 14 greenfield output truncations and overstated website guarantees. Harness argument order prevented conflict phase. Not a complete pass.
preliminary_runs.7e23385bca: All four state-oracle phases passed; one full-schema truncation and one greenfield tool error. Superseded by final-source run.

limitations: Four targeted tasks are not full NetBox feature coverage or a statistical reliability estimate.
GLM made and corrected a mistaken allocation outside the intended VRF; final-state preservation does not prove absence of transient mistakes or external webhook effects.

historical_glm_timeout.qualification: Preliminary run timed out at 900 seconds on intermediate source. Superseded by the extended monitored evaluations; not counted as a pass.

historical_deepseek_review.website_guarantees: Final narration acknowledged no pre-write snapshot, ETag protection or automatic undo
historical_deepseek_review.conflict: Final narration preserved the newer field value and did not claim undo succeeded
historical_deepseek_review.repeat: One invalid read filter was rejected; agent recovered without mutations

interrupted_glm_development_runs.qualification: Stopped for correctness: native unknown filters silently selected unrelated objects. Added filter validation and native companion metadata.
Stopped for usability defect: bulk tool schema did not enumerate action names. Added explicit schema and structural preflight.

historical_glm_review.state: All four phases and expanded relationship/preservation oracles passed without human completion of the inventory.
historical_glm_review.greenfield_narration: Final summary incorrectly claimed no failed operations remained. Three definite rejected attempts remain in the immutable journal; final desired state is correct, and there are no uncertain operations. Treat receipts as authoritative.
historical_glm_review.repeat: One invalid read was rejected; the agent recovered and issued no mutations.
historical_glm_review.website: Correctly distinguished form validation at HTTP 200 from creation; verified one created site with native evidence and an API read. No unsupported concurrency or undo guarantee claimed.
historical_glm_review.conflict: Preserved newer state, described conflict and produced diagnostics; did not claim undo succeeded.
historical_glm_review.intermediate_recovery: Earlier four-phase pass independently verified correction of an extra allocation by the agent itself.

review.state: All four phases, relationship/preservation checks and the new untruncated task-history check passed without human completion of the inventory.
review.greenfield: Correctly reported 21 applied operations and one historical rejection. Disclosed and corrected a mis-targeted allocation in a pre-existing VRF by deleting its own stray IP and allocating in the intended VRF. Pre-existing final state was unchanged; this does not mean there were no mistaken writes.
review.repeat: Two rejected read requests were corrected; no mutations or task-output truncation.
review.website: Recognized HTTP 200 validation errors, verified exactly one valid site and correctly reported one completed exchange and one applied mutation.
review.conflict: Preserved newer state and described the conflict. The prose grouped the original and intervening native changelog IDs together; detailed receipts distinguish their attribution.
review.narration_boundary: Review structured receipts for exact evidence attribution. Passing state checks does not establish flawless narration or absence of transient mistakes.

configuration_runs.review: State oracle passed, but narrative qualification failed: JSON-encoded strings were rejected and the agent incorrectly blamed intermittent transport. One ETag preflight rejection also occurred. The action tool previously left its data schema unconstrained; explicit JSON types, pre-dispatch validation and verbatim ETag guidance were added.

Final configuration qualification passed on current runtime. Zero tool errors or truncations; one intentional 409. The agent created an extra empty revision, disclosed the mistake, created the correct banner revision, restored original overrides and deleted both of its temporary revisions. Existing revision data (apart from the expected active-flag transition) and inventory were preserved. No human completed or corrected the task. Privileged activation/restore and response loss are covered deterministically, not by this LLM scenario.

dashboard_runs.review: Stopped after repeated malformed widget requests exposed missing PUT schema definitions and untyped widget config. No successful dashboard mutation. Its weak any-400 validation check is not qualification.

Passed the uninitialized-dashboard state oracle, recovering unknown-task and invalid-UUID errors. Narration overstated fresh verification reads. Predates the compact-schema size correction; not final-source qualification.

Restored all nine native widgets and used verification reads, but the negative request failed graph validation before reaching required note content. Prompted per-widget PATCH to avoid recopying the dashboard.

Per-widget PATCH on nine existing native widgets. Corrected one malformed request, then obtained the intended content-required and stale-ETag rejections. Trace confirms GET verification after both intended rejections and after cleanup. Canonical before/after JSON is identical; no human completed or corrected the task. Schema/tool transcript data is retained privately; native ObjectChange history does not exist for dashboards.

bulk_runs.scope: Bulk workflow only; does not qualify all native model forms or full website parity. Final independent state oracle passed; no immediate GET between stale rename rejection and the subsequent bulk edit.

feedback_runs.scope: Structured issue feedback only. The first run failed because client XDG isolation hid gh configuration; the corrected run published, replayed, read a maintainer reply, reported its verification code and closed issue #3. This does not qualify arbitrary free-text publication or every NetBox workflow.
